visualInspection.ui: Desktop light, desktop headwear light/dark, 390 px mobile light/dark, mobile fitting tool and the actual 512 px download were inspected. No visible layout clipping; A+W and SHIP IT remained legible.
visualInspection.independentCodeReview: No blocking findings in image caches, split registration, receiving-layer order, combined headphone transforms, temple-only drawing, halo fitting, source framing or share-state compatibility.

checks: All nine sections render their option thumbnails without failed images.
Petite and Wide labels, descriptions and historical share keys select the correct shapes.
Keyboard tabs, selected states, focus and skip link preserve the avatar.
Male/Female switch preserves the body and props, restores styling, supports arrow keys, share/reload, Surprise me and style-specific reset.
New scenes/colors survive reload; the Stickers section can equip the laptop.
Text normalization, copied share URL and reload reproduce the exact canvas.
Crop toggle, reset and Surprise me update the real preview.
Laptop sticker limit permits six selections and rejects a seventh.
New body shapes, hair colors, jewelry, props, gestures and six new stickers are reachable through the actual controls.
Hair clips add a hairstyle; explicitly choosing no hair removes the clip.
Concurrent body/skin thumbnails match sequential renders in both mobile themes (2-channel-value tolerance).
390 px light/dark layouts: no horizontal overflow; all visible buttons meet 44 × 44 px.
Failed body request shows retry; retry recovers after the connection is restored.
Fitting tool includes empty holding hand, guards invalid scale input and fits its mobile controls without overflow.
Editor and fitting tool make no third-party requests.
1280px desktop dark headwear layout renders loaded thumbnails without horizontal overflow or script errors.

limits: Automated renders establish loading, state round trips and crop behavior; they are separate from visual inspection.
The headwear matrix is exhaustive only for the stated hats, hair states and body shapes, not every possible outfit or color.
Most matrix cells were inspected at 256 px, not at native source resolution.
Original separate 2D images retain baked lighting.
Physical Safari/iOS and Android device testing remains outstanding.
Interrupted preliminary and cancelled optional runs are excluded.

publication.event: Initial application deployment; later documentation-only commits may follow without changing the reviewed renderer.

preview.pageAccess: Protected preview page was unavailable to the verification connector; public production was used for browser checks.

environment.scope: Four live native exports and a share URL reload. Broad local matrices, mobile layouts and theme checks were not rerun on production.

nativeVisualInspection.method: Each actual production download was viewed at its original resolution.
